intro.text: A listener scholar on Venli's team in Narak, researching new forms.

items.text: About two and a half years into the war with the Alethi, Tusa attended a strategy meeting with Eshonai, Thude, Bila, Rlain and Harvo. Tusa was considered as a spy in the warcamps but judged too important to the research, and when Rlain volunteered, Tusa declared him perfect for the job.

Tusa worked with Venli's scholars in Narak, researching new forms and seeking to bring the Everstorm. Venli and Ulim chose Tusa as one of the few they trusted to be among the first to take a voidspren into their gemheart.
